描述_EN: this brick was made of four slabs of baked clay, with openings at both ends; traces of clay used to strengthen the interior and fingerprints are still visible. this brick is decorated with a stamped design of geometric motifs and standing figures, and captions describing them as officials in charge of guarding the tomb doors. it was part of the doorway of a grave. during the han dynasty (206 bc- ad 220) the structure of burial sites was intended to mimic the architectural elements of a house, such as pillars, rafters, doorways or tile ends.
